description: Send an invoice (or the next part of it) and get a single-use pay link. Who may send is shops.sendPermissions: the owner always may, office for any job, a lead for jobs on their crew, and a field worker for jobs assigned to them, until the owner turns that off. Lines an agent drafted stay unsent until a person who may send invoices sends them. An agent token cannot send those lines. Earlier pay links stop working. Refused with conflict on a Doing Work deposit invoice whose booking ended (shop cancel or no-show). payments_ready false means the shop has no active payments account yet (after a hand-off, connect one with payments.connectLink); the link shows payment isn't available until it does.

amount_minor.description: Amount to ask for now. Defaults to the deposit on the first send, then the balance.

email_customer.description: Also email the customer a branded email with their own pay link, from the shop. Default false: you share pay_url yourself.

percent.description: Progress billing: ask for this percent of the invoice total now (capped at the balance). Use instead of amount_minor.

name: invoices_send
